elements.text: Design a locker system like Amazon locker where delivery delivers can deposit packages and can them up using a code

elements.text:
Primary Capabilities

- Are there different sized compartments?
- How does the customer get their code? Do we need to send an SMS or email?

Error handling

- Can one customer have multiple packages in the system at once? Are access tokens unique per package?
- How long do the code last? What happens to a package if it's never picked up?
- What if all the compartments of a given size are full when driver tries to deposit?

Scope Boundaries

- What's in scope of this system? Are we modeling the whole delivery flow or just the piece form the driver
arrives at the
locker untill the customer picks up
